question: who donates the most to Labor

payload.answer:
Shop Distributive & Allied Employees' Association Vic Branch provided the most disclosed funding to Labor: $42,837,142 in financial years 1998-99 to 2025-26.

- CFMEU Mining & Energy Division provided disclosed funding: $32,152,941 in financial years 1998-99 to 2025-26.

These disclosed party receipts cover only the published selection, rather than an exhaustive industry total or personal payments, and a donation is not evidence that it influenced a vote or speech.

**Westpac Banking Corporation** has the largest disclosed total to Labor in this published selection: **$55,227,183**. These figures rank disclosed receipts, which include more than gifts; they are not a donations-only ranking.

**Financial years: 1998–99 to 2025–26.** 306 donors with matching receipts in Opax’s selected map. Federal (AEC). Disclosed party receipts, including more than gifts; amounts in Australian dollars, without inflation adjustment.

| Donor | Disclosed receipts | Records |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| [Westpac Banking Corporation](/subject/donor/Westpac%20Banking%20Corporation) | $55,227,183 | 500 |
| [Shop Distributive & Allied Employees' Association Vic Branch](/subject/donor/Shop%2C%20Distributive%20and%20Allied%20Employees%20Association) | $42,837,142 | 533 |
| [CFMEU Mining & Energy Division](/subject/donor/Construction%2C%20Forestry%2C%20Maritime%2C%20Mining%20and%20Energy%20Union) | $32,152,941 | 751 |
| [Australian Workers Union](/subject/donor/The%20Australian%20Workers%27%20Union) | $19,907,893 | 588 |
| [Communications, Electrical and Plumbing Union - Electrical, Energy and Services Division](/subject/donor/Communications%2C%20Electrical%20and%20Plumbing%20Union%20of%20Australia) | $17,926,857 | 696 |

These are **party receipts, not personal payments to politicians**, and not all receipts are gifts. An industry grouping is not proof of coordinated lobbying or influence.

Coverage: Only receipts included in Opax’s published map are ranked. This is a selection, not every donor or an exhaustive industry total. Years use the first year of each financial year; election returns may use the polling year. Undated records are excluded from year-filtered answers.
